title:
Valued below
*your price?*

lines.say: You agree to buy a flat for 700,000 dollars. The valuation comes back at 670,000.
Your loan is based on the lower of the two: the valuation.
So the 30,000 dollar gap, the cash over valuation, has to come from you.
For HDB flats, it must be paid in cash. No CPF.
Useful so far? Follow for more.
Before you make an offer, check recent prices for the same block and floor range.
And keep a cash buffer for a gap you didn't plan for.
Save this before your next viewing.

caption:
Agreed to buy a flat for $700,000, but the valuation came back at $670,000? 🏠

Your loan is based on the lower of the two: the valuation. So the $30,000 gap, the cash over valuation, comes from you. For HDB flats, it must be paid in cash. No CPF.

Before you offer, check recent prices for the same block and floor range, and keep a cash buffer.

Save this before your next viewing 👇
